info.name: DLMS Dashboard Admin & Employee API
info.description: SYRTAK / DLMS official dashboard authentication, RBAC, and employee management.

item.name: 04 - Employee Management
item.description: Query params for GET /dashboard/employees: search, role_id, is_active (0|1), page, per_page (10|20|25|50), sort_by (name|email|created_at), sort_direction (asc|desc), optional user_type (admin|employee). Response includes items, pagination (with from/to), statistics, and role_options. Auth: Bearer {{dashboard_token}} or {{super_admin_token}}. Permission: manage_employees.

request.description: Default list. per_page defaults to 20. Returns items, pagination, statistics, role_options.
Existing roles endpoint (permission: view_roles). List employees also embeds data.role_options with id, name, display_name.
Sets is_active=true. Idempotent if already active. Audit: employee.activated
Sets is_active=false. Blocks self-deactivation and last active super_admin. Audit: employee.deactivated
Legacy. Prefer activate/deactivate. Optional body is_active true|false; omit to flip.

item.name: Fines employee cannot access audit logs
05 - License Types Settings
item.description: Dashboard license types CRUD. Permission: manage_settings. Query: search, is_active, page, per_page (10|20|25|50), sort_by (name|code|created_at), sort_direction (asc|desc). Code is immutable after create. No DELETE.

exec: try { var j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data && j.data.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('license_type_id', String(j.data.id)); } catch (e) {}

request.description: code cannot be changed after creation.
Expect 422 (empty name, duplicate code, invalid age/years).

item.name: 06 - Service Types Settings
item.description: Dashboard service types CRUD. Permission: manage_settings. Query: search (name|code|description), is_active, page, per_page, sort_by, sort_direction. Code is immutable (used by ServiceCode workflows). No DELETE.

exec: try { var j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data && j.data.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('service_type_id', String(j.data.id)); } catch (e) {}
